lxc_97c80e0daa2ac25a.text: Meet the world of Elden Ring, learn how the game works, and see how its writers and studio created it.

lxc_2255f74ce0fe9809.text: Elden Ring is a 2022 action RPG.

lxc_22a09962c417a474.text: In this kind of game, you control a character, explore, fight, and become stronger.

lxc_fbc131915fafaf01.text: FromSoftware, a Tokyo game studio, led its creation in there.

lxc_4708c4634563fada.text: Bandai Namco published the game outside Japan, while FromSoftware published it in Japan.

lxc_01b3859637fc08c7.text: Hidetaka Miyazaki, the director of Elden Ring, directed the project.

lxc_7878b87aaa65d2fa.text: The game first came out on 25 February 2022.

lxc_e62ec63d3c1715bd.text: People could play it on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S.

lxc_c7fb2850cf0b7897.text: The Lands Between is the world of Elden Ring.

lxc_e0d9ec4bbf662272.text: It is an open world, so players have a lot of room to wander and choose where to go.

lxc_4dfd2ab14d7f0dbc.text: You play as a Tarnished, the kind of character the player is.

lxc_e659f80f033dab91.text: This character is an exile who is called back to repair the Elden Ring and become Elden Lord.

lxc_aa65367df4883a0e.text: Travel is important because the world is very large.

lxc_f525e47788fa97c9.text: You can ride a horse named Torrent.

lxc_049de006fb9f671a.text: You also meet enemies and fight them with different weapons or with magic.

lxc_c7cab221f784d277.text: The game’s roots reach back to Demon's Souls, an earlier game that started this style.

lxc_2383b88ebc895e90.text: It came out in 2009 and made hard fights and death part of learning.

lxc_ea6a040e57f76cd6.text: Dark Souls, an earlier FromSoftware hard action game, followed in 2011.

lxc_9aa211b6b0d13a0c.text: Its areas used narrower paths, and players had to put parts of the story together.

lxc_3fb527d19fc6c7c1.text: Production of Elden Ring began in early 2017, after work on extra content for Dark Souls III.

lxc_f2c81a9f51ca9b2e.text: The studio wanted to keep this difficult style but place it in a bigger open world with more freedom to wander.

lxc_e6be2c5d860690e9.text: Hidetaka Miyazaki joined FromSoftware in 2004, when he was 29.

lxc_8001462d99fc25ed.text: He first worked as a game planner.

lxc_96bf4d8dd32e1710.text: Later, he took over Demon's Souls when the project was in trouble and helped shape the finished game.

lxc_0e5081131acfd934.text: He then directed Dark Souls and became president of FromSoftware in 2014.

lxc_7419f0a34b484d9f.text: In his games, the story often does not arrive through many long movie scenes.

lxc_6523e324b0277a7a.text: Players find parts of it in short item texts and in the places they visit.

lxc_8d4d499e42206286.text: This style asks players to look carefully and connect small pieces of information.

lxc_f9ee094e556fa48b.text: Martin, the writer of the mythic background for the world, had a special job.

lxc_e9e6e398d40fbdc1.text: Hidetaka Miyazaki asked him to create the old background of the world.

lxc_9f557c604af12332.text: This gave the team a history behind the people and events in the game.

lxc_6562a2a098eaa398.text: However, Martin did not design the fights or the open world.

lxc_de46ce2e421ff7f3.text: He also did not write the item texts that players read.

lxc_fda2f15860178abb.text: FromSoftware built the game and its play.

lxc_3d952a948605d8a0.text: Miyazaki stayed the lead writer for the story that players meet during their journey.

lxc_b4aa492ef7db1f38.text: Elden Ring was shown to the public at E3 in June 2019 and was released in February 2022.

lxc_5d03ea2adfcc7d32.text: Later that year, it received major prizes.

lxc_eab90322f74fb9e8.text: The Game Awards is a yearly show that names the year’s best games.

lxc_98d6e02357e9cce1.text: On 8 December 2022, Elden Ring won Game of the Year there.

lxc_5f6ec71682fdc5a4.text: It also won Best Game Direction, Best Art Direction, and Best Role Playing Game that night.

lxc_4817d1c2ba769e84.text: Its audience continued to grow after release.

lxc_2e4d5f21ffb1af08.text: By April 2025, the game had sold more than 30 million copies.
